ArtWorkout in its current state is *not* going to help you learn how to draw. While some of the courses do teach you things like volume and shading, during the drawing segments (if there is one), you only get lines to trace/color in rather than being able to practice drawing (on the app) what you've learned. Calling all of the courses "courses" is also misleading since only a few of them are actually lessons. (Also, 99% of the courses are locked behind a paywall.)

This game is just a cash grab. the first thing your hit with is an "optional" paywall but really it just limits everything about the app. But there isn't much to miss about the art because although it is a step-by-step process letting you know how to draw the general shape, you are very limited on what you draw as it is very strict and you can't include any creativity or style. Finally, in the "multiplayer" part of the game, you are just playing with obvious bots.
